title: Mario & Luigi: Partners in Time - Toad Town
description:
This is some depressing music...

...Actually, that game has a LOT of depressing music.

It's the somber music from Toad Town in Mario & Luigi: Partners in Time.

It would fit Ghost Houses or possibly castles.


Credit not required, this took me under 3 hours. It was a TINY song! :D
